body:
REAL ROOT CAUSE of the live AI standing still while training elo climbed normally: ai_opponent_build_observation() stopped writing at 21 of the real 31 S430 observation dims (the posture one-hot) -- obs[21..30] were uninitialized stack garbage fed into the live policy net every frame, even though the 10 relational-feature helpers it needed (ai_opponent_time_to_any_blast_normalized, ai_opponent_facing_toward, etc.) already existed in the same file, fully correct, just never called. Training stayed healthy (pure Python build_observation always filled all 31) so this was invisible in elo. Added the missing block; hand-verified bit-for-bit against rl_env_packet.py's own build_observation() for an identical synthetic state -- all 31 dims match exactly. New tests/test_ai_opponent.c locks this down, wired into scripts/build.sh. Full build + all 5 C test suites pass. Commit c77f1c1.

⚓ ☃
title: S457: implement the missing S430 relational-feature block in ai_opponent_build_observation
